parts.name: Cover
parts.Basic_description: This is the cover of the trash can, made of polypropylene plastic, typically rectangular and lightweight.
parts.Functional_description: The cover prevents odors from escaping and keeps the contents concealed. It can be lifted or flipped open when disposing of waste.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or hinge open and close, depending on the design mechanism.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: This is the main container body of the trash can, made of HDPE plastic, forming the primary storage volume.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and contains the waste materials, providing structural support for the cover and base.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the trash can, made of rubber, often including small wheels or pads for stability and mobility.
parts.Functional_description: It provides support and stability to the trash can, sometimes allowing it to roll or stay firmly in place.
parts.Movement_description: It may allow limited rolling or pivoting motion if equipped with wheels.
